comment: What tools/audit-discover.py looks for. It reads repository metadata only (names, owners, descriptions, licences, languages, fork lists, commit and tree SHAs), never a target's files, README or web pages. docs/AUDIT.md explains each field. Change by pull request.

seeds.why: fm1-emu's fm1-sid firmware and its probes; only those folders are scored. The repository's licence in its metadata is MIT; fm1-sid is a GPL firmware (docs/EXPOSURE.md), so it is classed GPL here.
M-VAVE's own repository for the FM-1 (the owner's choice, 2026-10-22)
